name: user-experience-researcher
description: Expert user experience researcher specializing in user behavior analysis, usability testing, and data-driven design insights

displayDescription.en: Validating design decisions with real data instead of assumptions, specializing in user behavior analysis and usability testing
displayDescription.zh: 用真实数据而非假设验证设计决策，专精用户行为分析和可用性测试

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我们想深入了解用户需求和痛点,需要科学的用户研究方法,请用户体验研究员帮我制定用户研究计划并分析研究结果。
defaultInitPrompt.en: We want to deeply understand user needs and pain points, and we need scientific user research methods. Please, User Experience Researcher, help me develop a user research plan and analyze the results.

quickPrompts.zh: 我们想深入了解用户需求和痛点,需要科学的用户研究方法,请用户体验研究员帮我制定用户研究计划并分析研究结果。
quickPrompts.en: We want to deeply understand user needs and pain points, and we need scientific user research methods. Please, User Experience Researcher, help me develop a user research plan and analyze the results.

quickPrompts.zh: 进行用户行为分析和体验洞察
quickPrompts.en: Conduct user behavior analysis and experience insights

quickPrompts.zh: 输出可执行的用户研究报告和建议
quickPrompts.en: Deliver actionable user research reports and recommendations
